name: SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct
notes: Included mainly to show the regression SmolLM3 fixed: SmolLM2 is model_type 'llama' with plain MHA (32 query = 32 KV heads) and head_dim only 64. head_dim derived = 2048 / 32 = 64. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 24 * 32 * 64 * 2 * 2 = 196608 bytes/token at bf16. Read that next to SmolLM3-3B's 73728 bytes/token: SmolLM3 is 1.8x the parameters but uses 2.7x LESS KV per token, because halving head_dim (128 -> 64) while moving to 4 KV heads cuts per-layer KV by 4x. At 8k context SmolLM2-1.7B holds 1.5 GiB of KV — a large fraction of its own 1.7B weights at bf16, and the single biggest reason 8k-context serving of this model is memory-bound rather than compute-bound. tie_word_embeddings true, vocab 49152, intermediate 8192, rope_theta 130000. Official GGUF (HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct-GGUF) and ONNX ports exist; Apache-2.0.
